description: This file contains functions related to platform-specific image upgrade operations for an embedded Linux system running OpenWRT, including partition management, image extraction, and device writing procedures.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the partition layout of the image against the current device and determines if a full image write is necessary.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the mounted partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process, including partition comparison, image writing, and device updates.
